name: Parking Ticket Management Workflow

data.label: Start Violation Processing
data.description: Initiates the parking ticket management workflow when enforcement officer detects violation

data.label: Capture Violation Details
data.instructions: Document violation details, vehicle info, and capture photo evidence

data.label: Validate Ticket Data
data.description: Validates all captured ticket information meets requirements

data.label: Validation Check
data.description: Route based on whether validation passed or failed

data.label: Return to Capture
data.description: Handle validation failure and return to data capture

data.label: Generate Ticket Number
data.description: Creates unique ticket number and sets issue timestamp

data.label: Calculate Fine Amount
data.prompt: Calculate fine amount for violation: ${processData.violationType} at location: ${processData.location} considering factors: time of day, repeat offense history, zone type
data.description: AI-powered fine calculation based on violation type, location, and circumstances

data.label: Notification Gateway
data.branches: Send notifications via multiple channels simultaneously
data.description: Parallel notification to vehicle owner via SMS, email, and mail

data.label: Send SMS Notification
data.template: Parking ticket ${processData.ticketNumber} issued. Fine: $${processData.calculatedFine}. Pay online or appeal within 30 days.
data.description: Send SMS alert to vehicle owner

data.label: Send Email Notification
data.description: Send detailed email notification with ticket details and payment options

data.label: Generate Mail Notice
data.description: Generate physical mail notice as backup notification method

data.label: Wait for Owner Response
data.description: 30-day waiting period for vehicle owner to respond (pay or appeal)

data.label: Owner Action Gateway
data.condition: Route based on owner action taken
data.description: Route workflow based on payment, appeal, or no action

data.label: Process Payment
data.description: Process payment through payment gateway and update ticket status

data.label: Review Appeal
data.instructions: Review appeal evidence and make determination on ticket validity

data.label: Appeal Decision
data.description: Route based on appeal approval or denial

data.label: Dismiss Ticket
data.description: Dismiss ticket and process any necessary refunds

data.label: Uphold Ticket
data.description: Uphold ticket decision and maintain payment obligation

data.label: Escalate to Collections
data.description: Escalate unpaid ticket to collections agency

data.label: Generate Analytics Data
data.description: Aggregate ticket data for reporting and analytics dashboard

data.label: Ticket Process Complete
data.description: Parking ticket workflow completed with final status recorded

dataModels.name: Vehicle

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the vehicle record

fields.name: licensePlate
fields.description: Vehicle license plate number

fields.name: state
fields.description: State or jurisdiction of vehicle registration

fields.name: make
fields.description: Vehicle manufacturer (e.g., Toyota, Ford)

fields.name: model
fields.description: Vehicle model name

dataModels.name: ParkingTicket
dataModels.description: Stores parking ticket records with violation details, status, and financial information

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique ticket number identifier

fields.name: vehicleId
fields.description: Reference to the vehicle that received the ticket

fields.name: violationType
fields.description: Type of parking violation (e.g., expired meter, no parking zone, handicap violation)

fields.name: location
fields.description: Street address or location where violation occurred

fields.name: issuedAt
fields.description: Date and time when ticket was issued

fields.name: fineAmount
fields.description: Fine amount in dollars

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current ticket status (e.g., issued, paid, contested, overdue)

fields.name: photoUrl
fields.description: URL to photo evidence of the violation

relationships.description: Each ticket is associated with one vehicle

dataModels.name: Payment
dataModels.description: Records payment transactions for parking tickets including transaction details, amounts, and payment methods

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parking ticket being paid

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Payment amount in currency units

fields.name: paymentMethod
fields.description: Method of payment (credit_card, debit_card, cash, check, online)

fields.name: transactionId
fields.description: External payment gateway transaction identifier

fields.name: paymentDate
fields.description: Date and time when payment was processed

fields.name: status
fields.description: Payment status (completed, pending, failed, refunded)

fields.name: gatewayResponse
fields.description: JSON string containing payment gateway response details

relationships.description: Links payment to the associated parking ticket

constraints.paymentMethod: Must be one of: credit_card, debit_card, cash, check, online
constraints.status: Must be one of: completed, pending, failed, refunded

routing.reasoning: Complex workflow with 8+ steps, multiple branching paths (pay/appeal), parallel processes (notifications, reporting), and sub-workflows (payment processing, appeal review). Relational data with normalized entities (tickets, vehicles, payments, appeals). Advanced forms with validation, conditional logic, and photo capture. Mobile-first for officers in field. Cross-platform needed for web admin and mobile enforcement.
